text: Rearrange the letters of the capital of Peru to make a word for letters and parcels.
why: Peru's capital is LIMA, and its letters rearrange to MAIL.

text: New York is 5 hours behind London. A 7-hour flight leaves London at 11am London time. What is the local time in New York when it lands?
why: It lands at 6pm London time (11am + 7 hours), which is 1pm in New York, 5 hours behind.
